evidence: Directly modifies chainstate management, AssumeUTXO, initial block download, block storage pipelines, and coins cache resizing.
rationale: This PR addresses a major architectural question in validation by exploring the complete removal of AssumeUTXO and multi-chainstate complexity. Resolving whether to eliminate background validation would relieve significant recurring maintenance overhead (netting over 5,100 lines removed) and clarify the trust model, setting the direction for concrete follow-up simplifications.
